rules.water: water share = (WorldCover 80 + WorldCover NoData) / WorldCover pixels; inside the AOI box a hex with no WorldCover pixels (the provider has no tile: open sea; also remote islets WorldCover does not map) counts as water share 1
rules.ocean: water hexes (share >= 0.50) 6-connected to an open-sea hex (inside the AOI box, no WorldCover pixels) -> Ocean; other water hexes -> Lake. Derived; NOT an official coastline (S16 absent)
rules.outsideAoi: the grid rectangle (Albers) reaches beyond the lon/lat AOI box; tiles were fetched for the box only, so hexes whose centre is outside the box and that have no WorldCover pixels are NO DATA (drawn as fog), never sea or land
rules.land: same order as the Chengdu sample: Glacier (ice >= 0.10), Plateau (mean >= 2800 m and relief < 700 m), HighMountain (relief >= 700 m and mean >= 3500 m), Mountain (relief >= 700 m), Hills (relief >= 150 m), Wetland (>= 0.20), Desert (bare >= 0.50), Grassland (grass+shrub+moss >= 0.50), else Plain
rules.relief: P98 - P2 of DEM heights inside the hex, 5 m histogram bins (GLO-90 DSM)
